mapper.select: SELECT s.user_card_id, s.base_year_month, s.prev_performance_amount, s.current_performance_amount, s.shared_limit_used FROM user_card_monthly_state s JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = s.user_card_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.base_year_month IN (#{baseYearMonth}, #{previousYearMonth})

SELECT u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id, u.used_amount, u.used_count, u.last_applied_date, u.daily_used_amount, u.daily_used_count FROM user_benefit_usage u JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = u.user_card_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.base_year_month = #{baseYearMonth}

SELECT u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id, SUM(u.used_amount) AS used_amount, SUM(u.used_count) AS used_count FROM user_benefit_usage u JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = u.user_card_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.base_year_month BETWEEN #{fromYearMonth} AND #{toYearMonth} GROUP BY u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id

SELECT s.user_card_id, SUM(s.current_performance_amount) AS performance_amount FROM user_card_monthly_state s JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = s.user_card_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.base_year_month BETWEEN #{fromYearMonth} AND #{toYearMonth} GROUP BY s.user_card_id

SELECT sel.user_card_id, sel.option_group_code, sel.selected_option_key FROM user_card_benefit_selection sel JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = sel.user_card_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.card_status = 'ACTIVE' AND sel.base_year_month = #{baseYearMonth}
